segment.description: Forge Creek (GNIS 01328209), a Roan Creek tributary in Johnson County, TN (HUC 06010103 Watauga) with its mouth near 36.434,-81.776. Identity resolved from the catalog hydroIdentity plus WQP station metadata - TDEC stations named 'Forge Creek' with CountyCode 091 (Johnson) and HUCEightDigitCode 06010103 (TDECWPC-FORGE000.5JO at 36.4342,-81.7764; FORGE001.2JO at 36.4412,-81.7706; TDECWR_WQX-TNW000002492 at 36.43294,-81.78059; TDECWR_WQX-TNW000002493 at 36.4342,-81.7770). This excludes the other Tennessee Forge Creeks (Knox/Sevier/Great Smoky areas) by county + HUC-8. USGS's monitoring-location identity service was persistently 503 this week; WQP station columns were used instead.
segment.boundaries: Catalog gives no reach limits; TWRA stocks it countywide as 'Forge Creek'. Record covers the main stem river-mile 0.5 to 1.2 above the Roan Creek confluence, which is where all agency monitoring sits.

coldSource.notes: Small upland creek: the on-creek USGS station (03481575, Forge Creek near Walnut Grove) lists only a 14.2 sq mi drainage area; catalog describes it as small, brushy, and rain-flashy. TDEC winter grabs at RM 0.5 read 0.43-1.05 C (Jan-Feb 2001-2007), showing a cold winter regime, but no gorge/canopy/elevation citation was found.

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation of any kind found for Forge Creek; no creel, survey, or independent angler sources from acceptable domains mention the creek outside the stocking season.

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout documentation found: Forge Creek is not named in TWRA's Region IV Trout Fisheries Report 2017 wild-trout discussion (which names Beaverdam Creek, Doe Creek, Laurel Fork, and Doe River for this region), is absent from TWRA's Wild Trout Streams and delayed-harvest regulation lists (2026 regs page grepped), and no TWRA or university stream-fish survey of the creek surfaced in searches.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: TDEC summer grab samples read a trout-friendly 17.3-18.7 C in every sampled summer 2001-2016, but the only recent sample (21.8 C, Jul 21 2026, near the mouth) is above comfortable trout range, and with the Mar-May stocking season over by June there is zero documented trout presence the rest of the year.
